question_stem:
A child kicks a ball so that it leaves horizontal ground with a velocity of 28 m s^{-1} at an angle of 34°
to the horizontal, as shown in Fig. 1.1.
Air resistance is negligible. The ball leaves the ground at time t = 0.
question_stem_latex:
A child kicks a ball so that it leaves horizontal ground with a velocity of 28 m $s^{-1}$ at an angle of 34°
to the horizontal, as shown in Fig. 1.1.
Air resistance is negligible. The ball leaves the ground at time t = 0.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the horizontal component v_{H} and the vertical component v_{V} of the velocity of
the ball immediately after it has left the ground.
parts.question_text_latex:
Calculate the horizontal component $v_{\mathrm{H}}$ and the vertical component $v_{\mathrm{V}}$ of the velocity of
the ball immediately after it has left the ground.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.question_text: Show that the ball reaches its maximum height at time t = 1.6 s.
parts.question_text_latex: Show that the ball reaches its maximum height at time t = 1.6 s.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.question_text:
On Fig. 1.2, sketch the variation of v_{H} with time t between t = 0 and t = 3.2 s. Label your
line H.
parts.question_text_latex:
On Fig. 1.2, sketch the variation of $v_{\mathrm{H}}$ with time t between t = 0 and t = 3.2 s. Label your
line H.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.question_text:
On Fig. 1.2, sketch the variation of v_{V} with time t between t = 0 and t = 3.2 s. Assume that
velocity in the upward direction is positive. Label your line V.
parts.question_text_latex:
On Fig. 1.2, sketch the variation of $v_{\mathrm{V}}$ with time t between t = 0 and t = 3.2 s. Assume that
velocity in the upward direction is positive. Label your line V.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
The total change in momentum of the ball between leaving the ground at t = 0 and landing on
the ground at t = 3.2 s is 13 kg m s^{-1}.
parts.question_text_latex:
The total change in momentum of the ball between leaving the ground at t = 0 and landing on
the ground at t = 3.2 s is 13 kg m $s^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the force that acts on the ball while it is in the air.
force = N
parts.question_text_latex:
Calculate the force that acts on the ball while it is in the air.
$force = N $

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.question_text:
Determine the mass of the ball.
mass = kg
parts.question_text_latex:
Determine the mass of the ball.
$mass = kg $
